title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, and the Ministry of Public Security on Strengthening the Investigation and Handling of Cases of Refusing to Pay Labor Remuneration
keywords_en: guarantee; strengthen the handling of cases of refusing to pay labor remuneration
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security
Ministry of Public Security

Notice on Strengthening the Investigation and Punishment of Cases Involving Refusal to Pay Labor Remuneration

Document No. [2012] No. 3 of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

To the Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Departments (Bureaus) of Human Resources and Social Security, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and the People's Procuratorate, Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security, and Public Security Bureau of Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

In order to implement the provisions on the crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration as set forth in the Criminal Law Amendment (VIII) of the People's Republic of China, improve the system of coordination between labor security supervision and enforcement and criminal justice, increase the crackdown on acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration and infringing upon workers' rights and interests, and effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of workers and social fairness and justice, in accordance with the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Provisions on the Transfer of Suspected Criminal Cases by Administrative Enforcement Agencies, and other relevant laws and regulations, the following notice is hereby issued to further strengthen the investigation, punishment, and judicial transfer of cases involving refusal to pay labor remuneration:

I. Unify Ideological Understanding, Attach Great Importance to the Lawful Investigation, Punishment, and Judicial Transfer of Cases Involving Refusal to Pay Labor Remuneration, and Severely Punish Illegal and Criminal Acts in the Field of Labor Security

At present, some enterprises and individuals either have the ability to pay but fail to pay workers' labor remuneration, or evade payment of workers' labor remuneration by transferring property, absconding, or other means. This has caused some workers to fall into financial difficulties and even triggered mass incidents, seriously infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of workers and affecting social harmony and stability. Lawfully punishing the illegal and criminal acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration and protecting the legitimate rights and interests of workers play an important role in resolving social conflicts, ensuring social harmony and stability, and promoting fairness and justice. Establishing a working system for the coordination between labor security supervision and enforcement and criminal justice is an important guarantee for lawfully performing duties and defending the legitimate rights and interests of workers, and is an inevitable requirement for severely cracking down on the illegal and criminal acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration according to law. People's courts, people's procuratorates, human resources and social security departments, and public security organs at all levels should further unify their thinking, attach great importance to, fully recognize the seriousness and harmfulness of such illegal and criminal activities, enhance political responsibility, closely cooperate with division of labor, lawfully transfer and investigate and punish suspected criminal cases of refusal to pay labor remuneration, promptly investigate and deal with a number of typical cases, effectively crack down on the criminal acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration, uphold the authority of the law, protect the legitimate rights and interests of workers, and promote harmonious and stable labor relations and social fairness and justice.

II. Earnestly Perform Duties and Lawfully Investigate and Punish Illegal and Criminal Cases of Refusal to Pay Labor Remuneration

Human resources and social security departments, public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts shall, in accordance with relevant regulations, conscientiously carry out the investigation, transfer, detection, review of arrests, review of prosecutions, and trials of suspected criminal cases of refusal to pay labor remuneration, maximize the efficiency of case handling, and promptly report the relevant situation.

Human resources and social security departments shall, according to law, supervise and inspect the compliance of employers with labor security laws, regulations, and rules, supervise the payment of labor remuneration by employers through various inspection methods, and lawfully accept reports and complaints of arrears of labor remuneration. Upon investigation, if the facts of the violation are clear and the evidence is conclusive, they shall lawfully and promptly order the employer to pay labor remuneration to the workers. If the actor absconds, the human resources and social security department may post the order to pay at the actor's residence, office, place of production or business operation, or the location of the construction project, or take appropriate measures such as delivering the order to pay to the actor's unit managers or close relatives. For cases suspected of being criminal, in accordance with the requirements of the Provisions on the Transfer of Suspected Criminal Cases by Administrative Enforcement Agencies, they shall verify the case facts, report to the head of the department for approval, then prepare the "Letter of Transfer of Suspected Criminal Case," and transfer the case to the public security organ at the same level within the prescribed time limit, with a copy submitted to the people's procuratorate at the same level for filing.

Public security organs shall, according to law and promptly, review and decide whether to file a case upon receiving from human resources and social security departments the transfer of suspected criminal cases of refusal to pay labor remuneration. If they believe that there are criminal facts and criminal liability should be investigated, they shall file a case according to law, promptly ascertain the criminal facts, correctly apply the law to punish crimes, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of workers from infringement.

People's procuratorates shall, according to law and promptly, carry out procuratorial work such as filing supervision, review of arrests, and review of prosecutions for such cases. They shall carefully review any clues of duty-related crimes discovered during work and handle them according to law.

People's courts shall, according to law and promptly, accept and hear various disputes over arrears of labor remuneration. Where such acts constitute crimes, they shall resolutely investigate criminal liability according to law.

During case review, public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts may inform workers of their right to initiate incidental civil actions in criminal proceedings.

State functionaries who fail to lawfully transfer or handle cases suspected of refusing to pay labor remuneration shall be investigated for administrative disciplinary liability according to law; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

III. Strengthen Coordination and Cooperation, and Properly Handle the Transfer of Cases Involving Refusal to Pay Labor Remuneration

When transferring suspected criminal cases to public security organs, human resources and social security departments shall attach the "Letter of Transfer of Suspected Criminal Case," the investigation report on the suspected crime of refusing to pay labor remuneration, the relevant documentary evidence, physical evidence, and other materials related to the suspected crime. If an administrative penalty decision has been made at the time of transfer, a copy of the administrative penalty decision shall also be sent to the public security organ and the people's procuratorate; if no administrative penalty decision has been made, in principle, the decision on whether to impose an administrative penalty shall be made after the public security organ decides not to file a case or withdraws the case, the people's procuratorate makes a decision not to prosecute, or the people's court makes a verdict of not guilty or exempts from criminal punishment.

Public security organs shall accept suspected criminal cases of refusal to pay labor remuneration transferred by human resources and social security departments and sign the receipt of the "Letter of Transfer of Suspected Criminal Case." If the case is not within their jurisdiction, they shall transfer it to the competent authority within 24 hours after acceptance and notify the human resources and social security department that transferred the case in writing.

Public security organs shall, within 3 days from the date of making the decision to file or not to file a case, notify the human resources and social security department that transferred the case in writing. If they decide not to file a case, they shall simultaneously return the case materials and provide a written explanation of the reasons for not filing the case.

If a human resources and social security department objects to the decision of the public security organ not to file a case, it may, within 3 days from receipt of the notice, request reconsideration from the public security organ that made the decision not to file a case, or may suggest that the procuratorial authority conduct filing supervision according to law.

In emergency situations such as when a large number of persons are involved, the crime is suspected to be cross-regional, the social impact is significant, or the suspected perpetrator intentionally destroys accounting books, transfers property, absconds, or violently resists law enforcement, the human resources and social security department shall promptly notify the public security organ, and the public security organ shall lawfully and promptly handle the matter.

Higher-level human resources and social security departments and public security organs shall supervise and inspect the implementation of this notice by lower-level human resources and social security departments and public security organs, regularly sample the handling of cases, and promptly correct problems and errors in the transfer of cases.

IV. Establish a Communication Mechanism to Ensure Effective Coordination Between Labor Security Supervision and Enforcement and Criminal Justice

In the process of handling cases involving refusal to pay labor remuneration, human resources and social security departments, people's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs at all levels shall strengthen communication, coordination, and full cooperation to form a joint force to combat such acts. Human resources and social security departments at all levels shall establish a liaison mechanism with local people's courts, people's procuratorates, and public security organs for the transfer of cases involving refusal to pay labor remuneration, strengthen joint action and coordination, ensure smooth work cohesion, and timely and powerful investigation and punishment of cases. They shall regularly hold joint meetings to exchange information on the investigation and punishment of illegal and criminal acts and the coordination between labor security supervision and enforcement and criminal justice, study and solve problems in the coordination work, propose measures to strengthen the coordination work, and effectively crack down on the criminal acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration. They shall improve the information notification system, achieve information sharing through various forms such as bulletins, meetings, and the internet, and promote the in-depth development of the coordination between labor security supervision and enforcement and criminal justice.

V. Increase Publicity Efforts and Timely Publish the Results of the Investigation and Punishment of Cases Involving Refusal to Pay Labor Remuneration

All localities shall use various channels such as radio, television, newspapers, periodicals, and the internet to publicize to the public the harm of illegal and criminal acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration and vigorously promote the determination to crack down on such acts according to law. They shall support news media in carrying out supervision by public opinion, maintain smooth channels for information exchange, carefully investigate and handle acts of refusing to pay labor remuneration reported by news media, properly carry out publicity and reporting on relevant cases and guidance of public opinion, and publish the serious illegal and criminal cases investigated and punished according to law to the public, achieving the purpose of punishing illegal and criminal acts and deterring criminals.
